project_name.justification: The article is titled 'ALX Resources Corp. Acquires Blackbird Project in Northern Saskatchewan' and the text states, 'ALX Resources Corp. ... is pleased to announce that it has acquired the Blackbird Project ("Blackbird", or the "Project") in northern Saskatchewan, Canada.'

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the first sentence: 'ALX Resources Corp. (TSXV: AL) (FSE: 6LLN) (OTC: ALXEF) ("ALX" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has acquired the Blackbird Project...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The press release is signed 'On Behalf of the Board of Directors of ALX Resources Corp. "Warren Stanyer" Warren Stanyer, CEO and Chairman'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states: 'ALX Resources Corp. ... has acquired the Blackbird Project ... Blackbird consists of twelve mineral claims staked in June 2024 on behalf of the Company...'. Acquiring a project by staking claims on behalf of the company implies a 100% interest.

primary_commodity.justification: The acquisition was motivated by a nearby discovery, as stated: 'ALX made the decision to acquire the Blackbird claims following the announcement on June 17, 2024 by Ramp Metals Inc. ("Ramp Metals") of a high-grade gold discovery...'. The CEO also refers to it as an 'emerging gold discovery'.
